outcome: Vaginal birth after cesarean section (VBAC) rate
cohort: 299 women with one previous cesarean section and a current singleton-term pregnancy who underwent balloon catheter cervical ripening and IOL at Longhua District Central Hospital in Shenzhen, China between January 2015 and December 2018
finding: Lower fetal weight (< 4000 g), lower BMI (<30 kg/m2), and higher Bishop score after cervical ripening (>6) were independently associated with an increased chance of VBAC following balloon catheter induction of labor.
